item.title: Drake Maye's huge day has Patriots surging and leaves Raiders reeling
item.description: Maye looked like his old self for the second straight week, throwing four touchdowns passes and running for a fifth score.
item.media:description: Drake Maye threw for 374 yards and four touchdowns, and the Patriots scored their most points in a regular-season game since 2021.

item.title: Packers punch Bears in the mouth, jump back into NFC North race
item.description: The Packers exacted revenge on the Bears for two losses last season, dominating the defending NFC North champions 31-7.
item.media:description: Jordan Love threw two touchdown passes in the Packers' win over the Bears.

item.title: Houston's big day: Texans beat Titans for first win, announce deal for Marvin Harrison Jr.
item.description: C.J. Stroud threw a touchdown pass and ran for another in Houston's victory. The QB has yet to throw an interception this season.
item.media:description: C.J. Stroud unleashes a pass while under pressure during Sunday's game.

item.title: Vikings stay unbeaten with win over Saints, show they're more than Brian Flores' defense
item.description: Minnesota overcame two red-zone turnovers with a highlight-reel touchdown grab from Justin Jefferson and physical run game in New Orleans.
item.media:description: Justin Jefferson's highlight-reel touchdown grab helped push the Minnesota Vikings to 5-0.
